title: Tearful Regine Velasquez sings to fans 'And I’m Telling You I’m Not Going'

blocks.text: Regine Velasquez brought the audience to tears on the last day of her “Finale” concert series as she delivered her final and emotional performance of Jennifer Holliday’s “And I’m Telling You I’m Not Going.” “Never akong nakarelate sa kantang ‘to, until now. Isn’t that weird? I’m not even sure if I can actually sing it,” she said prior to her performance of the song on Monday, Oct. 19 at the Mall of Asia Arena. “And I don’t know if I can finish it because I’m going to be very emotional.
